package pluginhost

// Capture harness for the fixtures in this directory. It records the exact bytes CPA's callPlugin
// sends for each call chat-archive decodes, encoded by the moego JSON library CPA uses from
// v8.0.74, and the same values encoded by encoding/json for comparison. All values are synthetic.
//
// It is never added to the CPA tree; go test's -overlay compiles it into internal/pluginhost of an
// exported CPA source tree (git archive v8.0.76):
//
//	echo '{"Replace":{"<cpa>/internal/pluginhost/zz_capture_test.go":"<this file>"}}' > overlay.json
//	CAPTURE_OUT=<dir> go -C <cpa> test -overlay overlay.json -run TestCaptureMoegoWire ./internal/pluginhost/
//
// Each <name>.moego.json in <dir> is copied here as <name>.json. Against v8.0.74 (router-for-me/moego
// v0.1.3) and v8.0.76 (MoeForge/moego v0.1.0-alpha.4) every file equals its .stdlib.json byte for
// byte. CompletedAt is time.Now() at capture time.

import (
	"context"
	stdjson "encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/v8/sdk/pluginabi"
	"github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/v8/sdk/pluginapi"
)

type captureClient struct{ raw []byte }

func (c *captureClient) Call(_ context.Context, _ string, request []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	c.raw = append([]byte(nil), request...)
	return []byte(`{"ok":true,"result":{}}`), nil
}
func (c *captureClient) Shutdown() {}

func TestCaptureMoegoWire(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("CAPTURE_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("CAPTURE_OUT not set")
	}
	zone := time.FixedZone("", 5*3600+30*60)
	started := time.Date(2026, 11, 17, 16, 4, 5, 123456789, zone)
	completed := time.Now() // carries a monotonic reading and the local zone
	requested := time.Date(2026, 11, 17, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	// 0x00..0xff (not a multiple of 3, so padded), HTML characters and invalid UTF-8 in the bytes.
	body := []byte("{\"model\":\"ca-claude\",\"text\":\"<b>&amp;</b>   café \xff\xfe\"}")
	for i := 0; i < 256; i++ {
		body = append(body, byte(i))
	}
	headers := http.Header{"Content-Type": {"application/json; charset=utf-8"}, "X-Multi": {"a<b", "c&d"}}
	exec := map[string]any{"requested_model": "ca-claude", "request_path": "/v1/messages", "caller_scope": "c0ffee",
		"execution_session_id": "sess-1", "generate": true, "excluded_auth_ids": []string{"auth-a"},
		"request_id": "rid-exec", "trace_id": "trace-1", "count": 3, "ratio": 0.5,
		"frontend_auth_metadata": map[string]string{"source": "authorization"}}
	ident := map[string]any{"caller_scope": "c0ffee", "access_provider": "config-inline",
		"frontend_auth_metadata": map[string]string{"source": "authorization"}, "request_id": "rid-list"}
	cases := []struct {
		name, method string
		req          any
	}{
		{"before-auth", pluginabi.MethodRequestInterceptBefore, rpcRequestInterceptRequest{RequestInterceptRequest: pluginapi.RequestInterceptRequest{
			RequestID: "rid-exec", TraceID: "trace-1", SourceFormat: "claude", Model: "ca-claude", RequestedModel: "ca-claude",
			Stream: true, Headers: headers, Body: body, CallerScope: "c0ffee", Metadata: exec}, HostCallbackID: "cb-1"}},
		{"after-auth", pluginabi.MethodRequestInterceptAfter, rpcRequestInterceptRequest{RequestInterceptRequest: pluginapi.RequestInterceptRequest{
			RequestID: "rid-exec", SourceFormat: "claude", ToFormat: "claude", Model: "ca-claude-upstream", RequestedModel: "ca-claude",
			Headers: headers, Body: body, Metadata: exec}}},
		{"response", pluginabi.MethodResponseInterceptAfter, rpcResponseInterceptRequest{ResponseInterceptRequest: pluginapi.ResponseInterceptRequest{
			RequestID: "rid-exec", SourceFormat: "claude", Model: "ca-claude", RequestedModel: "ca-claude", RequestHeaders: headers,
			ResponseHeaders: headers, OriginalRequest: body, RequestBody: body, Body: body, StatusCode: 200, Metadata: exec}}},
		{"model-list-response", pluginabi.MethodResponseInterceptAfter, rpcResponseInterceptRequest{ResponseInterceptRequest: pluginapi.ResponseInterceptRequest{
			RequestID: "rid-list", SourceFormat: "openai", ResponseHeaders: http.Header{"Content-Type": {"application/json; charset=utf-8"}},
			Body: []byte(`{"object":"list","data":[{"id":"ca-claude"}]}`), StatusCode: 200, Metadata: ident}}},
		{"model-list-complete", pluginabi.MethodRequestComplete, rpcRequestCompletion{RequestCompletion: pluginapi.RequestCompletion{
			RequestID: "rid-list", SourceFormat: "openai", Outcome: pluginapi.RequestCompletionSucceeded, StatusCode: 200,
			StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: completed, Metadata: ident}}},
		{"chunk-header-init", pluginabi.MethodResponseInterceptStreamChunk, rpcStreamChunkInterceptRequest{StreamChunkInterceptRequest: pluginapi.StreamChunkInterceptRequest{
			RequestID: "rid-exec", SourceFormat: "claude", Model: "ca-claude", RequestedModel: "ca-claude", RequestHeaders: headers,
			ResponseHeaders: http.Header{"Content-Type": {"text/event-stream"}}, OriginalRequest: body, RequestBody: body,
			ChunkIndex: pluginapi.StreamChunkHeaderInitIndex, Metadata: exec}}},
		{"chunk-payload", pluginabi.MethodResponseInterceptStreamChunk, rpcStreamChunkInterceptRequest{StreamChunkInterceptRequest: pluginapi.StreamChunkInterceptRequest{
			RequestID: "rid-exec", SourceFormat: "claude", Model: "ca-claude", RequestedModel: "ca-claude",
			ResponseHeaders: http.Header{"Content-Type": {"text/event-stream"}}, Body: []byte("event: ping\ndata: {\"x\":\"<&>\"}\n\n"),
			ChunkIndex: 0, Metadata: exec}}},
		{"complete", pluginabi.MethodRequestComplete, rpcRequestCompletion{RequestCompletion: pluginapi.RequestCompletion{
			RequestID: "rid-exec", TraceID: "trace-1", SourceFormat: "claude", Model: "ca-claude", RequestedModel: "ca-claude",
			Stream: true, Outcome: pluginapi.RequestCompletionFailed, StatusCode: 502, Error: "upstream <b>&</b> \xff   failed",
			StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: completed, Metadata: exec}}},
		{"complete-zero-times", pluginabi.MethodRequestComplete, rpcRequestCompletion{RequestCompletion: pluginapi.RequestCompletion{
			RequestID: "rid-zero", SourceFormat: "claude", Model: "ca-claude", Outcome: pluginapi.RequestCompletionCanceled}}},
		{"usage", pluginabi.MethodUsageHandle, pluginapi.UsageRecord{RequestID: "rid-exec", TraceID: "trace-1", Provider: "claude",
			BaseURL: "http://127.0.0.1:9/v1?a=1&b=<2>", Model: "ca-claude", APIKey: "sk-synthetic-<&>", AuthID: "auth-a", Source: "ops@example.invalid",
			Generate: true, Stream: true, RequestedAt: requested, Latency: 1500 * time.Millisecond, TTFT: 250 * time.Millisecond,
			Failed: true, Failure: pluginapi.UsageFailure{StatusCode: 502, Body: "bad \xff <gateway>"}}},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		client := &captureClient{}
		if _, err := callPlugin[rpcEmptyResponse](context.Background(), client, c.method, c.req); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", c.name, err)
		}
		std, err := stdjson.Marshal(sanitizePluginRequest(c.req))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s stdlib: %v", c.name, err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, c.name+".moego.json"), client.raw, 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, c.name+".stdlib.json"), std, 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}
